job.title: Registered Nurses - Premium Private Clinical Services Bahrain
job.description:

We are recruiting experienced Registered Nurses who combine outstanding clinical expertise with exceptional patient care and communication skills.

This is a unique opportunity to work within a premium healthcare environment delivering personalised treatments to an international clientele while helping establish a centre of clinical excellence from its inception.

As part of a specialist nursing team, you will provide safe, compassionate and evidence-based patient care throughout the treatment journey. You will work independently while collaborating closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team to deliver the highest standards of care.

Responsibilities include:
  • Performing comprehensive patient assessments
  • Peripheral IV cannulation, including patients with difficult venous access
  • Administration of intravenous infusion therapies
  • Continuous patient monitoring throughout treatment
  • Recognition and management of infusion-related complications
  • Delivering outstanding patient education and support
  • Maintaining accurate clinical documentation
  • Upholding the highest standards of infection prevention, patient safety and clinical governance

Applicants should possess:
  • Current Registered Nurse qualification
  • Minimum 2 years' recent post-registration clinical experience
  • Strong intravenous cannulation and infusion therapy skills
  • Experience working independently with excellent clinical judgement
  • Outstanding English communication skills
  • Confidence caring for an international patient population
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification
  • Eligibility for, or willingness to obtain, NHRA registration in Bahrain
Preferred Experience
Applications are particularly welcomed from nurses with experience in:
  • Infusion Therapy
  • Emergency Nursing
  • Critical Care / ICU
  • Post Anaesthesia Care Unit (PACU)
  • Outpatient Procedure Units
  • Day Surgery
  • Ambulatory Care
Additional experience in the following will be highly regarded:
  • Medical aesthetics
  • Cosmetic injectables
  • Medical spas
  • Cosmetic or dermatology clinics
  • Regenerative medicine
  • Biologic therapies
Clinical Competencies
Successful candidates will demonstrate competence in:
  • Advanced peripheral IV cannulation
  • Management of difficult venous access
  • Safe administration of IV therapies
  • Recognition and management of:
    • Infiltration
    • Extravasation
    • Vasovagal episodes
    • Allergic and hypersensitivity reactions
    • Early fluid overload
ACLS certification is desirable but not essential.
Language Requirements
  • Fluent English is essential.
  • Arabic language skills are highly desirable.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for nurses who are:
  • Professional and patient-centred
  • Confident communicators
  • Compassionate and approachable
  • Meticulous in clinical practice
  • Comfortable working autonomously
  • Able to manage multiple patients while maintaining exceptional standards of care
  • Passionate about delivering an outstanding patient experience
Employment Package
  • Competitive salary aligned with market rates
  • Premium private healthcare environment
  • Modern facilities and equipment
  • International multidisciplinary team
  • Initial contract from 6 to 18 months
  • Minimum commitment of 6 months
  • Preference for 18-month appointments
  • 12-month contracts available with opportunity for extension
International Applicants
Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified Registered Nurses from all countries. Selection is based on clinical competence, professional experience and suitability for this specialist role rather than country of qualification.

Licensing
Candidates must be eligible to obtain registration with Bahrain's National Health Regulatory Authority (NHRA). Assistance and guidance with the licensing process will be provided where appropriate.

Apply Now
Recruitment is commencing well in advance of the September 2026 service launch to allow sufficient time for interview, selection and professional licensing.

job.title: Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist - Arabic Speaking
job.description:
The Opportunity
A hospital is seeking an experienced, Arabic-speaking Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist to join its specialist medical team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Western-trained consultant to practise within a major private hospital offering advanced medical services, modern clinical facilities and multidisciplinary care.

The facility is a 300-bed healthcare organisation employing more than 400 physicians across over 40 specialties. The hospital provides patient-centred care guided by international standards, clinical excellence and a holistic approach to health and wellbeing. 

The successful candidate will provide comprehensive consultant-level obstetric and gynaecological services to a diverse patient population. Fluency in Arabic is essential for this appointment.

Key Responsibilities

The Consultant Obstetrician and Gynaecologist will:
  • Provide specialist assessment, diagnosis and treatment for obstetric and gynaecological patients.
  • Manage normal and high-risk pregnancies at consultant level.
  • Provide antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care.
  • Perform gynaecological surgery and obstetric procedures within the candidate's approved scope of practice.
  • Manage acute and elective gynaecological conditions.
  • Participate in the consultant on-call rota.
  • Work collaboratively with maternal-fetal medicine, neonatology, anaesthesia, radiology, pathology and other clinical services.
  • Maintain high standards of patient safety, clinical governance and medical documentation.
  • Contribute to departmental education, quality improvement and service development.
  • Communicate sensitively and effectively with patients and their families in both Arabic and English.
Essential Requirements Applicants must:
  • Hold a recognised primary medical degree.
  • Have completed specialist training in Obstetrics and Gynaecology in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada or the United States.
  • Hold one of the following specialist qualifications:
    • FRCOG with UK CCT in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, or an accepted equivalent UK specialist training credential;
    • FRCSC in Obstetrics and Gynaecology;
    • American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology certification.
  • Be eligible for Consultant classification and professional registration with the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties.
  • Have substantial post-specialist clinical experience in Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
  • Be fluent in spoken Arabic.
  • Have excellent written and spoken English.
  • Demonstrate strong communication, leadership and multidisciplinary working skills.
  • Maintain current professional registration and good standing in the country of practice.
Desirable Experience Preference may be given to candidates with:
  • Recent experience in a leading Western hospital or internationally accredited private hospital.
  • Expertise in high-risk obstetrics.
  • Advanced gynaecological or minimally invasive surgery skills.
  • Experience caring for private and internationally diverse patient populations.
  • An established record of teaching, clinical governance or service development.
  • A relevant subspecialty interest.
Remuneration and Benefits

A competitive consultant employment package will be offered, appropriate to the successful candidate's qualifications and experience. Full information regarding remuneration, benefits, working arrangements and relocation support will be provided during the recruitment process.

Apply for This Position

Arabic-speaking Consultant Obstetricians and Gynaecologists who meet the specialist qualification requirements are invited to submit:
  • A current and detailed CV.
And later:
  • Copies of specialist qualifications.
  • Evidence of current professional registration and good standing.
  • Details of Arabic and English language proficiency.
  • A brief summary of current clinical practice and specialist interests.

job.title: General Medicine Accredited Advanced Trainee Registrar - 2027
job.description:
An excellent opportunity is available for a new Advanced Trainee in General Medicine seeking a 12-month accredited Core Training appointment for 2027.
Based at a major regional teaching hospital in Victoria, this position offers broad General Medicine experience, daily consultant supervision, specialist outpatient exposure and a comprehensive education programme. The role is designed to support the development of confident, well-rounded General Physicians and provides an excellent environment for progression through Advanced Training.

The Position The successful Advanced Trainee will work with one of three inpatient General Medicine teams:
  • Gastroenterology
  • Neurology/Renal Medicine
  • Endocrinology
Each team includes Interns, Hospital Medical Officers and a Basic Physician Trainee, with close supervision and support from consultant physicians.

The Advanced Trainee will manage a broad range of acute and chronic medical conditions and gain experience in both inpatient and outpatient medicine.

There are also opportunities to manage complex and undifferentiated acute medical presentations within the Acute Medical Unit (AMU).

Some weekend duties are required, including consultant-supervised ward rounds, with rostering undertaken in accordance with the applicable Enterprise Bargaining Agreement.

Clinical Training

Daily consultant-led ward rounds are a central component of the position. As clinical experience and competence develop, the Advanced Trainee may have opportunities to lead ward rounds under consultant supervision.
The position provides valuable exposure to:
  • Acute and complex General Medicine
  • Gastroenterology
  • Neurology
  • Renal Medicine
  • Endocrinology
  • Perioperative Medicine
  • Acute Medical Unit presentations
  • Outpatient specialist medicine
Advanced Trainees will also attend outpatient clinics selected, where possible, to complement their individual training requirements and career objectives. These may include Gastroenterology, Neurology and Perioperative Medicine clinics.

Accredited Advanced Training Applications are invited from new Advanced Trainees in General Medicine seeking a 12-month Core Training appointment in 2027.

This is an accredited Advanced Training position offering structured clinical experience and supervision within a supportive physician training environment.
It represents an excellent opportunity for doctors progressing through physician training who wish to combine high-quality accredited training with the breadth of clinical experience available within a major regional referral hospital.

Education and FRACP Training Support

The hospital has a strong teaching and learning culture, with access to both internal and external educational programmes.
The successful trainee will have access to:
  • Internal physician education programmes
  • External education through the Austin/Northern teaching network
  • Victorian IMG (VIMG) educational sessions
  • Grand Rounds
  • Journal Club
  • Basic Physician Trainee teaching
  • Consultant-led clinical education
Active participation in departmental teaching is expected.
The Advanced Trainee will also be encouraged to support FRACP examination candidates and assist the Directors of Physician Education with examination preparation and coordination.

These responsibilities provide useful opportunities to develop teaching, leadership and medical education skills alongside clinical training.

Research and Quality Improvement

Professional and academic development are actively supported.
The successful applicant will be encouraged to undertake a quality improvement or research project during the appointment, with opportunities to work alongside experienced consultant physicians.

This combination of clinical training, education, research and leadership experience provides a strong foundation for a future career as a General Physician.

Candidate Requirements

This vacancy is specifically open to new Advanced Trainees in General Medicine seeking accredited Core Training for 2027.
Applicants should have:
  • MBBS, MBChB or equivalent recognised medical degree
  • Appropriate medical registration with AHPRA, or eligibility to obtain registration before commencement
  • Completion of the training requirements necessary to commence Advanced Training in General Medicine
  • Appropriate postgraduate physician training experience
  • A demonstrated commitment to a career in General Medicine
  • Strong clinical assessment and decision-making skills
  • Effective communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills
  • Commitment to teaching, continuing professional development and evidence-based medicine
  • Ability to participate in the required after-hours and weekend roster
The successful candidate will also be required to provide evidence of the required immunisation record, including 2026 influenza vaccination, as part of the onboarding process.

The Hospital The position is based at a large regional health service providing an extensive range of acute, specialist and tertiary-level services.

The Clinical Operations Division encompasses medical, surgical, critical care, cancer, women's and children's and mental health services. Specialties include General Medicine, Gastroenterology, Neurology, Renal Medicine, Endocrinology, Cardiology, Oncology, Emergency Medicine and Critical Care.

The scale of the service provides an excellent case mix for Advanced Training.
Each year, the health service manages:
  • More than 50,000 hospital admissions
  • Over 60,000 Emergency Department presentations
  • More than 100,000 specialist clinic service events
Modern clinical facilities and a large regional referral population provide Advanced Trainees with exposure to a wide range of common, complex and undifferentiated medical presentations.

Staff Benefits Benefits may include:

job.description:

  • Participation in ward rounds and clinical decision-making
  • Evening and weekend roster commitments
  • Providing rostered night cover
  • Working closely with consultant surgeons, accredited trainees, junior doctors, nursing staff and other clinical teams
The position provides considerable opportunities to develop practical surgical experience within a high-volume regional referral service.

Operating Theatre Experience
A significant advantage of this position is the opportunity for hands-on operating theatre exposure.

Depending on experience, case mix and appropriate supervision, registrars may participate as either primary operator or first assistant.

The role also includes rostered elective operating theatre exposure, providing further opportunities to develop operative skills and consolidate surgical experience.

Surgical Training and Mentorship
The department has a well-established Registrar Teaching Program and a strong commitment to education and professional development.
Registrars will have opportunities to:
  • Participate in structured surgical teaching
  • Develop operative and perioperative management skills
  • Teach medical students and junior medical officers
  • Develop clinical leadership skills
  • Participate in a surgical mentorship programme
  • Become involved in research and other academic activities
  • Prepare for the Generic Surgical Sciences Examination (GSSE)
  • Develop non-clinical competencies relevant to future surgical training
The combination of clinical responsibility, theatre exposure and structured professional development makes this an attractive position for doctors intending to pursue a career in surgery.

Candidate Profile

The position would suit a doctor with previous surgical experience who is ready to undertake responsibilities at Registrar level within an Australian hospital.
Candidates should normally have:
  • MBBS, MBChB or equivalent medical qualification
  • Eligibility for appropriate medical registration with AHPRA
  • Relevant postgraduate surgical experience
  • Clinical experience appropriate for appointment at HM25–HM30 level
  • Experience managing acute and elective surgical patients
  • Good clinical assessment and decision-making skills
  • Effective communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills
  • A demonstrated commitment to surgical training and professional development
Candidates will also be required to provide evidence of the required immunisation record, including 2026 influenza vaccination, as part of the appointment process.

The Hospital The position is based within a major regional health service providing comprehensive acute, surgical, medical, critical care and specialist services.

The hospital operates modern facilities and provides services including General Surgery, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care, Cardiology, Renal Medicine, Oncology, Women's and Children's Services, specialist outpatient services and Mental Health.

The scale and breadth of the service provide registrars with exposure to a substantial and varied patient population.

Each year, the service manages:
  • More than 50,000 hospital admissions
  • Over 60,000 Emergency Department presentations
  • More than 100,000 specialist clinic service events
This provides an excellent clinical environment in which to develop experience managing both acute and complex surgical presentations.


Staff Benefits
